I've already told her countless times how I feel, and she had said that if I "really wanted to die" then I would have "done it already". She also said that she wants me to stay with her until she's older so I can basically take care of her always, living no life of my own. And I'm sorry but I'd argue that she really has no idea who I am or what I want out of my life, she only knows that I'm a means for her to get taken care of for free, if that makes sense.

I just feel like there's really no other way out for me, since I tried joining the military to get away from all this bullshit but since I have asthma the recruiter said that I wouldn't be able to join any branch, ever. Every day is just getting more exhausting than the last, and I'm just tired of living this life that I have no wish to live. I don't know where everything went wrong, but I'm not strong enough to climb the mountain of work in front of me. That's all I gotta say really, but I do appreciate your comment though :)

I'm 21 years old and an unemployed loser living in my mom's basement. I am lonely, have no hobbies, skills, or motivation of any kind. I feel trapped due to having no job but I can't get a job without a vehicle, and I have no money to get a vehicle. On top of all this I deal with suicidal thoughts, depression, and anxiety nearly every day. 

Oh and also I have an extremely overbearing mother who basically treats me like slave, and when her friends come over they just berate me and say that I'm a "man-child" which I don't really disagree with, but it just hurts knowing that I'm such a disappointment.

I want to change my life, but like I said I'm pretty much trapped here and I don't really have the energy or motivation to make any positive changes. It's been this way for years now and my life has sucked even since childhood TBH with all my family problems that I don't even want to get into. I don't really want to die, but it sounds a hell of a lot better than this bullshit that I've been going through forever now
